visual.name: smartVisualsWrapped
visual.description: Your year in review as bold story cards, written by the visual from any fact table: headline total, peak month, week and day, top categories, biggest mover, streaks, records, milestones, a personality card and a summary, in English, Czech and German. Story paging for wall screens and a static grid for export. Premium: comparison with last year across the story, targets, a review for each person or team with awards and an export gallery, card builder and art packs. Part of the SmartVisuals visual family.
